metadata_policy.required_metadata_basis: Only mode, uid, and gid written literally in explicit sairedis mtree entries are requirements.
metadata_policy.observation_reference_treatment: Report actual values and comparisons to inherited/default and measured Make references; these references never gate pass/fail.
metadata_policy.root_ownership_inference: Discarded: shared mtree defaults do not create a component metadata requirement for the archive root or any other directory.

make_inventory.kind: measured native Trixie AMD64 Make package inventory

inherited.note: The shared debug tar has no component mode or ownership override.

inherited_generated_mtree.scope: Generated mtree directory entries only; this is not a component declaration for the archive root or synthetic entries.

archive_root.treatment: Report actual metadata. No literal component metadata is declared for this directory.

directory_contract.metadata_treatment: All directory metadata, including every normalized root member, is observational and never gates pass/fail.
